reactor-limpet: The top-mounted motor and drive transfer torque through the vessel head.
A half-pipe thermal circuit is welded to the vessel shell.
A bottom connection supports draining and product transfer.
exchanger: The channel head distributes tube-side flow into the bundle.
Flow enters and leaves the enclosed shell through dedicated connections.
Saddles support the horizontal shell. Any fixed and sliding arrangements depend on the design.
pressure: The formed head closes the shell and provides locations for equipment connections.
Nozzles provide connections for flow, instruments or protection devices.
anfd: The drive assembly moves the agitator during cake processing.
The jacket can support application-specific heating or cooling duties.
ribbon: The cover encloses the chamber that contains the blending assembly.
The end-mounted drive turns the horizontal ribbon shaft.
Product is discharged through a lower connection.
rmg: The bowl contains the materials during mixing and wet granulation.
The discharge connection transfers granules to the next process stage.
